profile.headline: Full Stack Software Engineer | Go | Javascript
profile.summary: Hey! My name is Conner, and I'm a Software Engineer from Memphis, TN, with around two years of experience. I've maintained and worked on .NET applications, specializing in SQL databases. My skill set is broad, and I have a passion for learning Go and C. I enjoy applying my knowledge to build applications from the ground up, focusing on practical, daily-use solutions.

positions.description: Software Engineer working on front end dashboards and backend apis.

positions.title: Software Engineer Teacher
positions.description: As a Classroom Teaching Assistant at CodeCrew Code School, I played a pivotal role in cultivating a dynamic learning environment for aspiring software developers. My core responsibilities encompassed meticulously managing attendance records, providing crucial support in grading software development assignments and tests, and actively assisting students during class hours. I not only demonstrated proficiency in teaching curriculum segments but also ensured that students received additional support to overcome challenges in the realm of software development. My strong foundation in computer science, coupled with excellent communication skills, allowed me to contribute significantly to the success of students in navigating the intricacies of software development. My commitment to CodeCrew's educational mission underscores my passion for fostering a new generation of skilled professionals in the field of software development.

positions.title: Food Service Order Clerk
positions.description:
Position Overview

 

The Cashier position greets and serves guests enthusiastically, suggestively sells menu items, serves food and drink products, rings up and collects payment for menu items and ensures all guests receive great food and service.

 

Essential Functions:

·       Ensures all guests receive great guest service.

·       Interacts and communicates with the guest confidently and authentically.

·       Greets guests, describes menu items/specials clearly and accurately, listens and responds to the guest and answers any questions.

·       Suggestively sells appetizers, drinks, desserts and add on menu items.

·       Rings items in the POS system and delivers items to the guest within the standard time limits.

·       Ensures accuracy of orders and food/drink quality standards.

·       Assists co-workers with various areas of guest service when needed.

·       Sets up, maintains and organizes workstation.

·       Ensures cleanliness of work area throughout shift and performs side work.

·       Maintains proper food storage temperatures and rotation using FIFO Method.

·       Uses knives, measuring ladles, scoops, scales, can opener, or other tools and utensils.

·       Follows safety procedures and standards when operating all equipment.

·       Follows health department standards for food handling, general cleanliness, and maintenance of work area.

·       Ability to handle multiple priorities, work under stress and exercise good judgment when dealing with guests and feedback.

·       Cooperates with co-workers and managers to meet the demands of the restaurant.

volunteerExperiences.description:
● Successfully led a team of 4 students, providing expert guidance and unwavering support, resulting in them winning 4th place.
● Employed exceptional problem-solving skills and critical thinking to conquer intricate challenges, ensuring the smooth progression of the program and empowering students to overcome obstacles. 
● Collaborated closely with fellow mentor leaders and  program staff, devising and executing highly effective strategies that significantly contributed to the overall success.

I volunteered in this program that has donated over 15,000 service hours to over 90 distinct area nonprofits, giving back to nonprofits in the community for charity. I integrated automation and a CRM sytem for a nonprofit called "Cooper Young Garden Club".

projects.title: BitBox
projects.description:
BitBox is a E-Learning platform that uses generative AI and more to let users code on their browser, while using AI to read their code on the fly and assist them.

BitBox is written with the following technology:
    Nextjs
    React
    TypeScript
    MongoDB
    judge0
    Openai
    Tailwind
    Docker
